description: This file defines the MessageCenter class within the Orleans.Runtime.Messaging namespace, implementing core messaging functionalities for Orleans silos, including message sending, receiving, processing, forwarding, rejection, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: MessageCenter
classes.description: Implements core messaging logic for Orleans silos, including message dispatching, forwarding, rejection, lifecycle control, and interaction with other components like connections and catalog.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops message processing, blocks application messages, and stops accepting client messages.

methods.name: BlockApplicationMessages
methods.description: Blocks outbound application messages, used for fast shutdown.

methods.name: SetHostedClient
methods.description: Assigns a hosted client to the MessageCenter.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a message to a proxy client or gateway.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message, handling routing, proxy delivery, and connection management.

methods.name: DispatchLocalMessage
methods.description: Processes a message locally without network transmission.

methods.name: RejectMessage
methods.description: Rejects a message with specified rejection type and reason.

methods.name: ProcessRequestsToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Handles messages targeting invalid activations, either rejecting or forwarding them.

methods.name: ProcessRequestToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Handles a single message targeting an invalid activation.

methods.name: TryForwardRequest
methods.description: Attempts to forward a message to another silo.

methods.name: ResendMessageImpl
methods.description: Resends a message, possibly forwarding to a system target or another silo.

methods.name: MayForward
methods.description: Determines if a message can be forwarded based on forwarding count.

methods.name: AddressAndSendMessage
methods.description: Addresses a message asynchronously and sends it.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Creates and sends a response message for a request.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming message, attempting local delivery or passing to the activation.

methods.name: ProcessMessageToNonExistentActivation
methods.description: Handles messages for activation that do not exist, possibly rejecting or sending a rejection.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection message in response to a message.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Implements asynchronous disposal, stopping message processing.
